pure_property_settings.scope: Pure dilute-gas viscosity and first-order binary molecular diffusion only; explicit zero-dipole LJ approximation. No mixture-viscosity, porous effective diffusivity, Darcy permeability, multicomponent flux, Soret or brick qualification. GRI NASA thermo and reactions are not imported. No post-fit calibration to NIST tables. NIST comparison pressure is unspecified on selected pages; agreement is not pressure-matched experimental validation.

reference_scope: 80-digit direct all-pairs source formula on actual binary64 pure inputs; production uses triangular reciprocal weights. Pure-property accuracy remains the separate source/experimental review.
